reason: The cited evidence (E1) mentions a TiAl/TiC composite coating on TC4 and reports significant hardness and wear resistance improvements, directly supporting the formation of hard phases and enhanced performance. However, it provides no specific evidence for microstructural refinement or the presence of compressive residual stresses, which are key premises of the proposed mechanism.
premises: Laser cladding of TiAl/TiC composite coating on Ti alloy forms hard intermetallic phases (TiAl, TiC).
The composite coating refines the near-surface microstructure.
The coating introduces compressive residual stresses.
The hard phases and refined microstructure increase surface hardness.
Increased hardness and compressive stresses reduce wear rate under sliding conditions.
